formulas.formula: Made for your phone. Open the Google Sheets app and tap a tab at the bottom.
Step 2: Budget. A plan for each category.
Step 3: Add Spending. Tap the next empty row: date, amount, category. Done.
Step 5: Today. What you can still spend, total and per day.
Step 6: Month. Your year, one line per month.
Step 7: Goals. Up to 6 savings goals with progress bars.
Tip: in the app, double-tap a cell to type. Tap the arrow in Category for the list.
Tip: type a date like 6/20 and Sheets fills in the year.
Tip: pin the Google Sheets app to your home screen for 5-second logging.
Savings counts as saved, not spent.
